name: html-paragraph-mixed-image-text-stays-paragraph
description: Negative guard for paragraph-wrapped image conversion: a paragraph that carries an image plus real text is genuinely mixed content. It stays an editable core/paragraph whose RichText keeps the inline image beside the words, and is never restructured into a core/image that would drop them.

source_reference.notes: Boundary for #2017 and #3020. Convert to core/image only when the paragraph's content is a single image ignoring insignificant whitespace; image plus text stays a paragraph.

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative guard for new paragraph-wrapped image conversion.
